title: 第16章 武学早课第17章 曹正堂喂招
slug: 镇守仙秦地牢吞妖六十年
content_zh:
武学司在镇抚司后堂。
早间点卯之前，晚间下值之后，半个时辰的课，由镇抚司中的中高层来教授讲学。
张远到武学司学堂时候，这里已经有十多人端坐。
“来，这边。”一道低呼声传来，一位穿着青袍的身影向张远招手。
昨日乙八队中那位同样使弓弩的皂衣卫。
张远走过去，挨着他坐下。
“我叫蒋青，乙八队的弓弩手。”看着张远，蒋青低声笑道，“张远，新人，我晓得。”
张远点头，微微拱手道：“见过蒋兄。”
他看看周围，来武学司听课的，基本上都是三十岁以下。
估计都跟他差不多，是新入镇抚司时间不长的。
“早间武学多是讲武道修行，晚间的要带纸笔，会有不少见闻与常识需要记录。”看张远是空手来，蒋青开口提醒。
这规矩张远还真不知道。
“多谢蒋兄。”
说话间，前方一道身影已经大步走来。
所有人站起身，身形挺直。
到来之人穿着黑色武服，头发以铁冠束起，腰间黑色的腰带。
四旬左右，面容刚毅。
“乙卫营营首，都尉曹正堂。”蒋青低声介绍。
前方，曹正堂抬手，示意所有人坐回坐席。
然后拿起长案上放着的纸卷，淡淡道：“点名吧。”

随着他话音落下，坐在最前方位置之人“噌”的站直身躯：“甲六队，陶青寒。”
第一位刚坐，下一位已经起身报名：“丁三队，赵三生。”
一道道报名之声此起彼伏，响亮，高亢。
蒋青报完名字，张远站起身：“甲四队，张远。”
提笔在面前纸页上勾画的曹正堂抬头看一眼，又低头继续圈画。
一共二十一位皂衣卫参加今日的武学讲课。
等所有人报过名，曹正堂放下笔，站起身，活动一下手腕手臂。
“今日我讲授镇抚司拳法劲力运转。”
一边说着，他一边缓缓抬脚，马步，冲拳。
“力从足底生，劲从腰背出。”
“内炼精气，外壮筋骨，年轻时候打什么样的底子，往后就有什么样的修为。”
曹正堂演练的不是张远修的铁甲拳，但此时他完全听的懂。
那些力量运转的讲述，展示，与自己通过真元运转感悟的竟然有七成都是相通。
剩下的三成，是自己感悟的似乎更细微，更灵动。
原来，自己的感悟是对的。
纯靠自己感悟时候，哪怕那种力量的运转，修为的提升不可能作假，但张远还是心中没有底。
现在与曹正堂的讲述印证，顿时心头踏实。
怪不得在牢房时候，那位镇守的前辈说镇抚司中武道什么都有，不需要求外人。
这种深入浅出的武学教授，哪里是别人随口几句能指点的？
“嘭——”
content_en:
The Martial Arts Department is in the back hall of the Zhenfu Department.
Before midnight in the morning and after the shift in the evening, half-an-hour classes were given by the middle and senior levels of the Zhenfu Division.
When Zhang Yuan arrived at the Wushu Si Academy, there were already more than ten people sitting here.
"Come over here." A low voice came, and a figure in a green robe waved to Zhang Yuan.
Yesterday, the Zaoyi guard from Team B8 also used a crossbow.
Zhang Yuan walked over and sat down next to him.
"My name is Jiang Qing, a crossbowman from Team B8." Looking at Zhang Yuan, Jiang Qing chuckled softly, "Zhang Yuan, I'm new, I know."
Zhang Yuan nodded, cupped his hands slightly and said, "I've met Brother Jiang."
He looked around and saw that most of the people who came to the Martial Arts Department to attend classes were under the age of thirty.
They are probably all similar to him, they are new to the Zhenfu Division and have not been here for a long time.
"The morning martial arts classes are mostly about martial arts practice. In the evening classes, you need to bring paper and pen. There will be a lot of news and common sense that need to be recorded." Seeing that Zhang Yuan came empty-handed, Jiang Qing reminded him.
Zhang Yuan really doesn’t know this rule.
"Thank you, Brother Jiang."
While he was talking, a figure strode forward.
Everyone stood up and straightened their bodies.
The person who arrived was wearing black military uniforms, with his hair tied up in an iron crown and a black belt around his waist.
Around forty years old, with a resolute face.
"The leader of the second guard camp, Captain Cao Zhengtang." Jiang Qing introduced in a low voice.
Ahead, Cao Zhengtang raised his hand and motioned for everyone to sit back down.
Then he picked up the scroll placed on the long desk and said calmly: "Let's call the roll."
As he finished speaking, the person sitting at the front straightened up: "Team A-6, Tao Qinghan."
The first person had just sat down, and the next person had already stood up to sign up: "Team Ding San, Zhao Sansheng."
The registration voices came one after another, loud and high-pitched.
After Jiang Qing announced his name, Zhang Yuan stood up: "Team A4, Zhang Yuan."
Cao Zhengtang, who was drawing on the paper in front of him, looked up, then lowered his head to continue drawing.
A total of twenty-one Zaoyi guards participated in today's martial arts lecture.
After everyone had signed up, Cao Zhengtang put down his pen, stood up, and moved his wrists and arms.
"Today I will teach Zhenfusi Boxing's powerful movement."
As he spoke, he slowly raised his feet, took a horse stance, and punched.
"Power comes from the soles of the feet, and strength comes from the waist."
"Refining the essence internally and strengthening the muscles and bones externally. What kind of foundation you build when you are young will determine what kind of cultivation you will have in the future."
What Cao Zhengtang was practicing was not Zhang Yuanxiu's Iron Fist, but he understood it completely at this time.
The descriptions and demonstrations of the movement of power are actually 70% consistent with what I have realized through the movement of true energy.
The remaining 30% is my own perception which seems to be more subtle and more intelligent.
It turned out that my perception was right.
When relying solely on his own perception, even if the operation of power and the improvement of cultivation level cannot be faked, Zhang Yuan still has no confidence in his heart.
Now that I have confirmed it with Cao Zhengtang’s story, I feel at ease.
No wonder when we were in the cell, the senior guard said that Zhenfu Division had everything in martial arts and there was no need to ask for help from outsiders.
How can this kind of martial arts professor who explains things in a simple and easy-to-understand manner be able to give pointers with just a few words?
"Bang——"
